summary: Completed frontend testing of TrusteD-V Build Pipeline Visualization component. All 10 test cases PASSED. The new BuildPipelineViz component renders correctly with all 7 pipeline steps, animated SVG scenes (satellite, PCB/oscilloscope, rocket launch), and proper scoped CSS.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BuildPipelineViz component uses dangerouslySetInnerHTML with scoped CSS (all selectors prefixed with .tv-pipeline, animations prefixed with tvp). CSS is injected dynamically via document.head.appendChild. Component has data-testid='build-pipeline-viz' inside data-testid='simulation-section'.

build_pipeline_viz_renders.details: BuildPipelineViz component renders inside simulation-section with data-testid='build-pipeline-viz'

all_7_pipeline_steps.details: All 7 steps render with correct titles: Step 1 Requirement, Step 2 Requirement Decomposition, Step 3 Core Engine — IP Accumulation, Step 4 Chip Engine — SoC Integration + PCB, Step 5 Code Engine — Firmware · Middleware · API, Step 6 Simulation & Testing — Hardware + Software, Step 7 Production Ready

step_2_mini_grid_cards.details: 4 mini-grid cards present: Sensing (CO₂, air quality, Temp + humidity, VNIR imaging), Compute (RISC-V CPU, NPU inference, LoRa + UHF), Power (Solar MPPT, Battery mgmt, NAND flash), Security (Root-of-trust, Crypto AES-256, IMU · GPS)

step_3_ip_chips.details: All 10 IP chips present: Ibex RV32IMC, OpenTitan, NPU IP, ADC IP, LoRa PHY, AES-256, MPPT IP, DMA ctrl, UART/SPI/I2C, Custom sensor bus

step_4_satellite_scene.details: Satellite scene SVG renders with dark background (#0a0e1a), animated satellite with solar panels, Earth with atmosphere glow, and blinking stars

step_6_simulation_scene.details: PCB simulation scene renders with UART Monitor text showing boot sequence, Signal Analysis waveform, RISC-V SoC chip, RF LoRa module, CO₂ sensor, Power MPPT, and ALL PASS status

step_7_launch_scene.details: Launch scene renders with rocket, animated flame, smoke effects, and 5 summary chips: IP (10 blocks), Chips (3 chips), SoC (unified), MW (RTOS+HAL), SIM (All pass)

engine_legend.details: Engine legend at bottom shows all 4 items: Core Engine (IP blocks), Chip Engine (SoC · chips), Code Engine (Firmware · API), Verification (HW + SW sim)

hero_section_engine_card.details: EngineArchCard renders in hero section with data-testid='engine-arch-diagram', showing TrusteD-V Engine title, 5 layers (Application API, Middleware, SoC/Module, Discrete Chips, IP Blocks), and 3 engine labels

made_in_india_badge.details: Made in India badge renders with data-testid='made-in-india-badge', tricolor flag, and 'Engineered for the world' subtitle

css_scoping_and_animations.details: CSS properly scoped with .tv-pipeline prefix. All 5 key animations loaded: tvpFadeUp, tvpFloat, tvpBlink, tvpBurnFlicker, tvpRise
